findings.issue: The frozen README proposes enforcing address availability before CID2 publication. The requested boundary explicitly keeps board MAC metadata independent from CID2 admission. BASIC_CONFIG contains no MAC field and resources.c correctly has no address dependency.
findings.required_before_native_promotion: Native CID2 admission must depend on actual owned capability/resource/lifecycle/transport prerequisites, without a board-address gate. Preserve address validation as separate retained metadata for later initialization; correct this documentation in a separately versioned candidate rather than altering frozen files.

Native must retain/authenticate exact same-session successful capability object and enforce one-way lifecycle/onepublication above these helpers.
